subject: Approval: SI-sourced microcredits for Silver Sand accelerator - compliance & disbursement
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@silversand.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Otis <ben@acceler8.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: small batch microcredits for Silver Sand accelerator cohort

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Silver Sand is excited to include Redwood in our next accelerator cohort (Dec 1 start). Our SI partner Acceler8 will run the technical onboarding.

Quick ask: can Redwood provision a small batch of partner-sourced promotional credits for 10 teams (each cap ~$1000) to be applied as trial fuel? The credit will be tied to accelerator enrollment and expire 90 days after issuance. This is a standard arrangement with our other infra partners and helps teams get to useful POCs during the cohort.

We need:
- Confirmation of approval path (who signs off)
- Any compliance/security checklist you need (SOC2, data handling notes)
- Typical timeline for issuing and how we provide recipient emails

Attaching the sponsor letter and a brief cohort outline. Ben (cc) is coordinating the SI onboarding.

Appreciate your help — want to finalize by next Tuesday so onboarding materials can include the credits.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships | Silver Sand Labs
attachment: SilverSand_Sponsor_Letter_signed.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@silversand.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Otis <ben@acceler8.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: small batch microcredits for Silver Sand accelerator cohort

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the materials. This is the right kind of partner-sourced promo we can support. High-level plan below; I'll kick off internal approvals once Soojin confirms the compliance checklist.

Proposed plan:
- Approval: Sales manager sign-off + finance ops (Marissa) for the disbursement schedule
- Credit model: 10 recipients, $1,000 each, expiration 90 days from issue, single-use coupon codes linked to recipient emails
- Security/compliance: Soojin to confirm whether we need a completed vendor attestation or SOC2 excerpt; if custom data access is required we’ll route through Private deployment options
- Timeline: If we get approvals by EOD Monday (11/23) we can issue codes on 11/30 to align with your Dec 1 cohort start

Soojin — can you confirm the minimum evidence you need? Marissa — are you able to handle the disbursement file (CSV of emails + code mapping) and run the activation with billing ops?

Elena/Ben — please confirm the recipient list format (CSV with email, company, cohort id) and whether you want codes pre-provisioned or created on-demand through our partner portal.

I’ll attach a short MOU draft for channel credits and copy the compliance checklist once we hear back.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@silversand.ai>, Ben Otis <ben@acceler8.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: small batch microcredits for Silver Sand accelerator cohort

Jonas / Marissa — I reviewed the sponsor letter and cohort outline. Quick notes from Security/Compliance: 

1) SOC2: We don’t need Silver Sand's full SOC2; a vendor attestation PDF and confirmation that no PHI is expected in trial data is enough.
2) Data residency: cohort teams will be on hosted Redwood API; confirm allowed regions (you requested US-only) — we can restrict token issuance to US region.
3) Logging/audit: we require that partner credit redemptions are auditable; please ensure we capture code->email mapping in our billing logs.
4) Expiration/rollback: add a 7-day rollback window for accidental issuance.

If those conditions are acceptable, I can clear compliance today. Marissa — please confirm the budget owner and whether this will be treated as marketing co-op or as a sales promotional credit. That determines accounting (expense coding).

Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena.park@silversand.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Otis <ben@acceler8.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: small batch microcredits for Silver Sand accelerator cohort

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable and we can meet the compliance items. 

Attached: signed sponsor letter (already included) and a one-page cohort recipient template. We prefer pre-provisioned codes mapped to emails so teams get a single-use code on Day 1.

We will provide the CSV by Tue morning (11/24). For accounting: Silver Sand covers the credits via an existing co-marketing commitment; the SI (Acceler8) will not be billed.

Let us know if you need the vendor attestation in a specific format (pdf or DocuSign).

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships | Silver Sand Labs

1) Compliance cleared by Soojin — documented in vendor portal.
2) Jonas to sign off final MOU; I'll countersign for funds release.
3) Elena: please send the CSV by 11/24 11:00 PT. We will generate single-use codes and deliver a mapped CSV + activation report by 11/30 (EOD).
